mapper.select: SELECT comment_id, post_id, member_id, parent_id, content, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM comments WHERE post_id = #{postId} AND is_deleted = 'N' ORDER BY created_at ASC
SELECT comment_id, post_id, member_id, parent_id, content, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM comments WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
SELECT comment_id, post_id, member_id, parent_id, content, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at FROM comments WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND is_deleted = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comments ( post_id, member_id, parent_id, content, is_deleted, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{postId}, #{memberId}, #{parentId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{content}, 'N', SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.update: UPDATE comments SET content = #{content}, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
UPDATE comments SET is_deleted = 'Y', deleted_at = SYSDATE, updated_at = SYSDATE WHERE comment_id = #{commentId}
